description.en: Send local files to WeChat from inside DeepSeek Harness. Ships a left-sidebar panel, the wechat_send_file tool and a send button on every DSH deliverable card, defaulting to the File Transfer chat, and is the quickest way to move desktop-side results onto a phone when DSH is driven remotely. The run reads the open chat with Windows OCR and refuses to paste unless the header matches; several conversations sharing a display name stop it with chat-ambiguous rather than guessing. WeChat 4 exposes no stable conversation id and OCR can misread, so this reduces but cannot guarantee against a wrong recipient; autoSend stays off by default. Files are picked through WeChat's own dialog because 4.1.15.13 ignores clipboard file pastes; results are confirmed by name plus size label, or by a structural change of composer and pane for images. If WeChat is not running the plugin starts it and clicks 进入微信; a QR-only screen is reported. Windows only; MIT.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里把本地文件发到微信，默认目标是「文件传输助手」。提供左侧栏面板、wechat_send_file 模型工具，以及每张 DSH 产物卡片上的「发微信」按钮。发送按两步处理：先读窗口标题，不是目标聊天就拒绝粘贴；会话列表里出现多个同名聊天时返回 chat-ambiguous 并中止，不做猜测。由于微信 4.x 不提供稳定会话 ID、OCR 也可能误识别，这能降低但无法绝对避免发错会话，因此默认不自动发送（autoSend=false），先把文件放进输入框由人确认。文件通过微信自己的「选择文件」对话框选取，因为微信 4.1.15.13 不认剪贴板里的文件；发送结果按文件名加大小标签确认，图片则按输入框与聊天区的结构变化确认。微信没在运行时会自动拉起并点「进入微信」；只有二维码时如实报告。也照顾远程场景：在手机上远程用 DSH 时，电脑上跑出的结果点一下就发到「文件传输助手」，手机微信里直接收到、保存到手机。仅支持 Windows，MIT。
